Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game, a clinical performance by Afghanistan while it was a poor effort from Bangladesh overall. Will the hosts seal the deal in the next game? Or will we see a fightback from the visitors? For all the answers, join us back on 5th June at 2000 Local (1430 GMT)... Adios!

Rashid Khan gets the Man of the Match award for his brilliant spell. His figures read 3-0-13-3 which turned out to be a match-winning effort. He thinks there is no secret to success. He was just trying to do his basics right and feels enjoying the game is very important. He doesn't believe in having specific plans for any batsman. He informs there was a little dew but it didn't matter in a big way as the ball skidded a lot and helped their spinners. He ends by stating that the confidence of doing well in the big games does help a lot.

Asghar Stanikzai feels that it is important to start on a winning note in such a small series. He was happy with the start which they got and momentum was with them from there on. He says they were pretty much aware about the conditions and expected his bowlers to do well on this ground. He thanks the crowd for supporting them.

Shakib Al Hasan feels they were good with the ball, but they lost the plot in the final ten overs and conceded too many runs. He thinks there is a lot they need to improve on before the next game. He opines Afghanistan played really well today and outplayed them in all the three aspects of the game. He reckons that his side will come back stronger in the next game. He wanted a big effort from the top-order batsmen in the run chase and feels partnerships are very crucial in such chases which they failed to get.

Rashid Khan was introduced late and he too joined the party with a double-wicket over. Mahmudullah did try his best at the end but he was left with too much to do. Shapoor Zadran's three-wicket over was the icing on the cake as Afghanistan took a 1-0 lead in the series.

A brilliant all-round effort from the Afghan team. They were simply outstanding with the ball tonight and never really allowed the visiting team to get on top. Earlier, the hosts posted a formidable total, thanks to a few cameos from their middle-order batsmen. In the second half, Mujeeb Ur Rahman struck with the very first delivery and got the big wicket of Tamim Iqbal. Shakib Al Hasan was soon to follow as he fell prey to Mohammad Nabi, who also bowled really well. Liton Das and Mushfiqur Rahim did try to get the run-chase back on track but Nabi once again provided the breakthrough. Following which, Bangladesh never really managed to get back into the game.

OUT! That is that! AFGHANISTAN WIN BY 45 RUNS and they take a 1-0 lead in the series. A low full toss outside off and the batsman mistimes the drive to covers. Rashid flies to his left and takes a spectacular catch to end the proceedings.
Slipping it down the leg side, Jayed looks to glance that one but misses it and the ball brushes his pads and rolls to the keeper.
Slower bumper from Janat on middle and leg, Jayed stays low and ducks under it as he lets it through to the keeper.
High full toss from Karim, the batsman slaps it to long on for a single. No signal from the umpire, the bowler should consider himself lucky to get away with that one.
Fullish delivery on the off stump line, Abu stays back and flicks it on the leg side towards the mid-wicket region. A single taken.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Abu Jayed is the last man in for the visitors.

OUT! BANG! The leg stump is broken in half. Lethal stuff! The pace and accuracy of the lanky pacer has made the life of the tourists extremely difficult. He goes full and bowls it in the line of the stumps. The batsman wants to hit the ball out of the stadium but misses it to find the furniture behind him disturbed. It's almost done and dusted in Dehradun and Afghanistan are advancing towards a clinical win.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Rubel Hossain walks out to bat.

OUT! The bouncer does the trick. Short, fast and angling away from Mahmudullah, who goes for a big swing. The ball hits the higher part of his bat and goes up in the air towards short fine leg. Three fielders are rushing in but Ghani calls for it and settles under it safely. He had a small collision with Shahzad but held his nerve.
Touch too straight from Zadran and the new batsman tucks it behind square for a single.
Nazmul Islam is the next man in for Bangladesh.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Another one bites the dust. Fullish delivery, angling in sharply. Hasan backs away, uses his feet but ends up yorking himself up. He is beaten for pace and the ball crashes into the leg stump. They need quick runs and they need someone to go for it but in the process, they have lost too many wickets.
FOUR! Bumper to start the over, angling into the body and the batsman goes for the pull but gets a top edge over the keeper to find the fence.
Shapoor Zadran is back into the attack.
FOUR! Some relief for Bangladesh and Mahmudullah. He gets a wide delivery from Rashid and chops it behind the point fielder to collect a boundary.
Spinning down leg, Mahumdullah tries to heave it away but is beaten by the sharp turn. The ball brushes his back leg and the fielder at short fine rushes in to stop the single. More pressure!
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Abul Hasan walks out to bat.

OUT! Another googly and another wicket. The stock delivery from the Afghan magician is working beautifully. He bowls it on middle and leg, enticing Hossain to play the big shot and he falls prey to it. He tries to slog sweep it but miscues it to long on. Usman Ghani stationed there takes an easy catch.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Plays the pull to the  flighted delivery towards the mid-wicket region and takes a single.
Rashid Khan is back.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. One run added to the total.
Darted in by the bowler and almost gets his man. Hossain manages to get his bat down in time. The ball goes to the point region and they take a single.
Slider from Mujeeb and the batsman flicks it off his pads to the on side for a single.
Goes for the sweep to the incoming delivery but misses.
Covers the line of the delivery and defends it back to the bowler.
Uses his wrists and works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is back into the attack.

SIX! Up and over! Beautifully done. Mahmudullah is their only hope now. He gets a fuller delivery in his half and plays the lofted cover drive to perfection. The power generated off the front foot and the swing of the bat is enough to take it over the boundary.

It's getting difficult for Bangladesh. They are not able to get the boundaries which they desperately need. Another square cut off the shortish delivery but he finds the backward point fielder and scampers for a single. Direct hit is needed but the fielder misses it.
Gets a low full toss on off stump but Hossain is unable to get it past the cover fielder.
The batsman tucks the shortish delivery towards square leg. One more run added.
Similar length. This time he gets the square cut behind point and takes a single.
Tries to cut the short of a length delivery but misses.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Darted in on the leg stump, Hossain tucks it straight to the short fine leg fielder. Looks for a single but the non-striker sends him back. There is a direct hit at the keeper's end and the umpire goes upstairs. The replays show that Hossain made it back in his crease just before the ball hit the stumps.
Low full toss on off and the batsman couldn't get it past the mid-wicket fielder.
Flighted delivery and driven through mid on for nothing.
The slower flighted delivery, outside the off stump, Hossain guides it behind the keeper and runs two.
Drives the straighter delivery to mid on and takes a single.
Finally gets some connection but couldn't get it past the point fielder.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

OH! This one goes the other way. Rashid is toying with the batsman. He keeps it on the same length and makes it go the other way. The batsman hangs his bat off the front foot but misses the line altogether.
Flighted googly outside off and hitting the batsman on his pad. Huge appeal from Rashid but the umpire is unmoved.
Short and tucked away to the mid on region for a single.
Flighted, outside off and nicely defended by the batsman.
Off cuter on a goodish length, the batsman flicks it with a wristy shot towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Short of a length on middle and leg. Hossain plays it to short fine leg and takes another single.
Similar length but this time the batsman punches it with soft hands to mid off and runs a single. Makes it safely in the end.
On a good length and punched to the mid off fielder for nothing.
Yorker from the bowler and the batsman digs it out to the off side.
Short of a length on the pads and the batsman tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Karim Janat is into the attack.
Defends it wide of the man at backward point. They steal a quick single. End of a brilliant over from Rashid, he has picked up a couple of important wickets and has got his side in the ascendancy.
Pushes it to the man at backward point.
FOUR! Well played! Hossain plays with an angled bat and steers it past backward point for a boundary.
Floated delivery on off, gets on the front foot and defends it out.
Wide! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Mosaddek Hossain walks out to bat and will face the hat-trick ball. There is a fielder under the lid at short leg, Afghanistan are on the attack.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Rashid is once again spinning his web over the opposition with the ball. He is a spin wizard and is making an impact on this game. He bowls a googly to Sabbir at a quicker pace. Rahman is probably not expecting it and is pretty late to react. He rocks on the back foot to flick that but misses it and gets rapped below the knee roll. Impact is right in front of the stumps and the umpire takes his time but raises his finger eventually, much to the delight of the hosts.
Sabbir Rahman strides out to bat.

OUT! Yes, he does! Delivers a body blow straightaway, but was it a special delivery? Definitely not, but Rahim made it look like one. He goes for the reverse sweep off the first ball the leggie bowls. A loopy delivery in line of the off stump, the ball spins away a wee bit and that is enough to make the difference. Rahim attempts an extravagant shot, the reverse sweep. However, he fails to execute it. The ball kisses his back leg and deflects onto the top of the off stump. Bangladesh continue to slip. They still need 88 runs from 59 balls.
Rashid Khan comes into the attack. His four overs will be very crucial in the game. He was extremely successful in the Indian T20 League but can he replicate a similar kind of performance today?
On middle and leg, Rahim guides it to the leg side for a single.
Another square cut off the length delivery. One run added to the total.
Flicks the slower delivery off his pads towards square leg and gets a single.
Driven through mid on for another single.
The batsman plays the square cut to the point region. They pick up a single.

Not Out! The all-rounder survives but what an effort from the young sensation! Can prove to be a vital moment. Mahmudullah goes for the slog sweep but gets a top edge as the ball flies over the square leg region. The fielder from the deep runs in to take the catch. He dives forward and seems that he has collected it cleanly. Rashid claims the catch but the umpire isn't convinced and takes it upstairs. The soft signal from the on-field umpire is not out. The replays roll in and they aren't convincing enough to overturn the decision. Rashid isn't happy with the decision as he is shaking his head with a cheeky smile.

Has Rashid taken it? He is claiming it and is pretty confident about the neatness of the catch but the umpires have a chat and send it upstairs. Soft signal is NOT OUT. Will the TV umpire have enough conclusive evidence to overturn the onfield call? Let's see.
Short of a length ball, taps it to vacant mid-wicket region. Retains the strike with a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries, after couple of dots, these are welcome runs for Bangladesh. Steps out and hits it on the rise through the covers for another boundary.
FOUR! Pulled away, a much needed boundary for Bangladesh! Short ball from Janat to test the batsman, but Mahmudullah is up to the task, he stands tall and pulls it away to the fine leg boundary.
Hangs back and dabs it on the leg side. Nabi rushes from mid-wicket to his left to prevent the single.
Stays in his crease and pushes it to the man at extra cover.
Rahim stays in his crease and steers it down to third man for a single.
Mahmudullah is the next batsman in.

OUT! Nabi gets his man. Das who was looking dangerous is walking back to the pavilion. Huge blow for Bangladesh. He was timing the ball nicely and one can say there was no need to play such a shot. He goes for the reverse-hit once again, gets into the position but misses the straighter one from Nabi. Gets hit on the right thigh, in front of the wickets and the umpire raises his finger without any hesitation. Well, the replays suggest that the impact might have been outside off. Afghanistan continue to chip away at the wickets.

In the air... and dropped! How costly will this be? Shapoor is the culprit. Rahim gets inside the line of the delivery to play it over the short fine leg fielder but only manages to get a top edge. Shapoor is a tall man but he still needs a leap to reach to the ball. He does get a hand to it but fails to grab it. He then tries to take it on the second attempt but fails again and hands a reprieve to Rahim.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot to long off. One run added to the total.
Dabs the floated delivery with soft hands to the on side and takes a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to the vacant mid-wicket region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tucks the floated delivery to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Mohammad Nabi is back into the attack.
Punched the short of a length ball off the back foot to backward square leg and takes a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads to fine leg. They pick up a single.
Wide! Bumper from Janat and it's way too high over the batsman's head. Umpire stretches his hands and signals a wide.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Gives charge and makes room for himself, gets the fuller ball and BANG! Rahim has creamed that over covers for a boundary. Aggressive stuff from the little man!
Punched off the back foot by the batsman to deep mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Plays the widish delivery with an angled bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Karim Janat comes into the attack.

Angled across Rahim who does well to get his bat on the shortish delivery. The ball drops near the stumps and they take another single. End of Powerplay - Bangladesh are 49/2. While, at the same stage, Afghanistan were 44/0. The visitors are five runs ahead but they have lost two crucial wickets.
Leg Bye! On a good length coming into the batsman, who goes for the flick but misses. Gets hit on his pads and takes a single.

FOUR! Easy peasy for Das! He gets a low full toss, outside off. A slower ball from Zadran gone wrong. All he has to do is get his bat on ball and get the placement right, which he does ever so easily. Creams it through cover-point for a boundary.

SIX! BOOM! He is not bothered by what's happening at the other end. On a goodish length coming into the body and Das presents the full face of the bat and hits it long over the sightscreen for a maximum.
Short of a good length, around the wicket, angling into the body and the batsman picks up the length quickly and heaves it to the deep mid-wicket region for two.
Angling into the body, short of a good length. Rahim tucks it to square leg for a single.
Shapoor Zadran is back for a new spell.

Das steps out and looks to play the lofted drive but gets a thick outside edge to short third man. A fumble there from Zapoor but he recovers quickly and throws at the bowler's end. A wild throw but the backing is good from the fielder at mid off.

In the air... but lands well wide of the man at short third man. Goes for the repeat of the shot he played off the first ball. Gets a top edge over the infield. Shapoor tumbles but manages to flick that inside the ropes. Another couple taken.
Pushes it quicker through the air, Rahim gently taps it on the leg side and gets off strike with a single.
Rahim walks right across his stumps and glances. The ball goes off his gloves past the keeper towards fine leg, they take a couple more.
Nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Wow, some innovation from Das! Loopy ball on off stump line, he gets into position quickly and reverse sweeps it over the man at backward point for a boundary.
Mujeeb to continue, this is his third on the trot. Afghanistan are on the attack, they want more wickets in the Powerplay.
Closes the face of the bat and tucks it wide of the square leg umpire for a single.
Rahim powers it away to deep mid on for a single.
Wide! Slipping it down the leg side, Rahim looks to glance that but misses it. Wide called.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the next batsman.

OUT! High in the air and taken... Nabi strikes and gets the big fish. Shakib departs after scoring just 15 off 15 balls. Bangladesh needed a big contribution from him but Nabi gets the better of him. Bowls a delivery much slower in pace and well outside off. Shakib looks for the slog sweep and ends up top edging it. The man with the mitts calls for it and makes no mistake. Does a small dancing gig to entertain the Afghan fans.
Shakib steps out and lofts it straight back over the bowler. The fielder from long off rushes to his left and manages to pull that inside the ropes. Saves a couple.
Das works it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Closes the face of the bat and taps it to short fine leg. Single taken.
Mohammad Nabi gets the ball.
Dabs it on the off side and they steal a quick single. Once again, a single off the last ball from Shakib.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Makes room and tries to play the square cut, but fails to make contact with the ball.
FOUR! Well played! Mujeeb drops it short and follows the batsman, who still manages to pull it away to deep mid-wicket. First boundary off Mujeeb in this innings.
Stays in the crease and pushes it gently towards the cover region.
Almost sneaks through. Shakib does well to get his bat down in time, a quicker ball from Mujeeb, skids through after pitching. The batsman just manages to defend it off the inner half on the track.
Shortish delivery, the batsman jumps back and chops it behind point. They settle with a single and Shakib retains the strike.

FOUR! Intelligent batting from the Bangladesh skipper. He walks a long way across his stumps and gets inside the line of it. Flicks it to the right of short fine leg for a boundary. No one out in the deep to stop that.
Jumps inside the line of it and glances it away to deep backward square leg for a single. Shakib is back on strike.

FOUR! Punched off the back foot! Beauty from Liton, he gets off the mark in a grand manner! Short of a length ball outside off, punches it sweetly between the two men at point and cover-point for a boundary.
Zadran steams in and bowls a shortish delivery, hurries Shakib, who mistimes the pull through square leg to the deep. Single taken.
Fuller length ball on off, Shakib lunges forward and pushes it to mid off.
Shapoor Zadran comes to bowl from the other end.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Sits on the back foot to play the square cut, but fails to put bat to ball.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Steps out and punches it back to the bowler, who has a shy and hits the stumps at the far end. The ball rolls wide of the keeper and they take a single.
Stays back and plays the square cut, finds the man at backward point.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out to bat.

OUT! Gone! First ball duck for Tamim. The southpaw looks a dead duck, Mujeeb delivers a decisive blow on the first ball. The visitors have lost one of their premium batsman without a run on the board. Exceptional start for Afghanistan, Mujeeb has carried his Indian T20 League form into this game. Bowls a straighter one on off and middle, Tamim shapes to sweep it initially, but seeing the trajectory, he changes his mind. He looks to defend but the ball hits him on the back leg. Loud appeal and the umpire obliges.
Welcome back. Bangladesh have a stiff target to overhaul. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das will open for Bangladesh. For Afghanistan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman will start the proceedings with the new ball.
